correctness.rationale: Proved existence/uniqueness for every n≥2 and positive a,b,T by positive definite K and Lyapunov integral. Projector-block inversion gives an exact covariance, and the previously known OU current identity then yields the rank-two antisymmetric A with a pointwise 2D flux image and exactly computed ±i eigenvalue pair. Heat balance follows from the Stratonovich formula and h_i=-(AK)_ii, with entropy production verified both via bath rates and a positive quadratic current expression. A three-bath parameterization is explicitly positive on epsilon strictly between zero and one quarter, preserves sum=3 and sum of squares=6 and hence fixes eigenvalues, while sigma diverges as the reciprocal of epsilon. A standalone standard-library exact-rational verifier independently solved 36 Lyapunov systems and checked current, spectrum polynomial, heat, and entropy; the proof rather than finite tests provides the general claim. Risks: no bound on currents in a more general network, and no zero-temperature limiting dynamics are claimed.

originality.rationale: Compared claims and hypotheses with the primary 2007 two-coordinate gyrator, the 2016 general OU angular-momentum theorem, the 2003 multi-thermostat nearest-neighbor harmonic crystal, and the 2021/2022 two-terminal all-to-all inertial model. The general Gaussian commutator formula is expressly identified as prior work: the claimed new scientific content is its arbitrary-n, fully heated complete-graph rank-two specialization with exact reservoir heat/entropy law and an explicit fixed-first-two-temperature-moments family with unbounded entropy at a constant circulation eigenvalue pair. Bounded searched public record results were compared by implication; none examined contains or directly establishes this entire parameter-specific thermodynamic theorem. Priority remains subject to unindexed equivalent specializations.
residual_risks: General linear Gaussian theory makes this solvable in principle; a previously unnoticed published all-to-all multibath specialization may already compute the same consequences.
Semantic research-record retrieval and bounded full-text searches do not certify priority or independence.

Only first portions of the longer 2003 and 2021 comparison papers were read; their appendices may contain relevant formulas not explicitly indexed, though their clearly different model definitions limit direct implication.
The physical interpretation of heat requires the specified overdamped equal-mobility Stratonovich convention; other thermostats and bond-resolved heat definitions are outside scope.

value.rationale: The question asks how many distinct irreversible circulation channels arise from arbitrarily many thermal reservoirs on a dense harmonic network, and whether fixed circulation strength measures energetic irreversibility. Exact rank-two collapse of the entire pointwise current field, an explicit complete-graph bath heat/entropy law, and the constructive failure of any entropy-production bound at fixed first two temperature moments and fixed nonzero integrated-circulation eigenvalues answer physically motivated structural questions. The fixed-moment counterfamily is not a mere renaming or numerical curiosity; it proves that a natural observable of macroscopic nonequilibrium rotations can underdetermine thermodynamic cost without varying the mean or variance of the bath ensemble. Scope is restricted to this natural uniform-coupling solvable family; no general network claim is made.
